computerUse.sectionDescription: In the Ai00-X desktop app, the assistant can capture the screen and control the mouse and keyboard; requires a multimodal model for vision.

browserControl.sectionDescription: Control your default browser through the Browser Extension (recommended) or Chrome DevTools Protocol. The Extension mode preserves your login sessions, cookies, and extensions without needing to restart the browser.
browserControl.desktopOnly: Browser control settings are only available in the Ai00-X desktop app.
browserControl.extensionStatusDesc: Status of the Browser Helper Extension connection. This is the recommended mode — no browser restart needed.
browserControl.statusDesc: Fallback: Chrome DevTools Protocol connection (requires browser restart with debug port).
browserControl.connectFailed: Failed to launch browser with CDP
browserControl.recommendedModeDesc: The best available browser connection mode. Extension mode is preferred as it does not require a browser restart.
browserControl.createLauncherDesc: Create a shortcut app that always starts the browser with CDP debug port enabled.
